system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each LLM stage in the workflow uses a modular prompt template with the same general organization, while the content of each section is specialized to the task at hand.
system_prompt_style.note: Harness code is closed (paper Data Availability); repo evidence is the openSIL target codebase, not the harness.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a VDB implemented using Chroma stores and retrieves existing functions (knowledge base), existing UTs (ground truth), and reusable test doubles (libraries).
env_context_strategy.note: Default configuration unclear; LCA-only variant disables VDB retrieval. Inputs also include FUT source file.

context_compaction.note: No harness code or config available; paper does not describe history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Builds the UT with EDK II and saves the compiler/linker output
observation_format.note: Compiler logs, dispatcher output, LCOV line maps fed to prompts.

tool_call_format.note: No tool-calling; LLM nodes return fixed output schemas (Sec. 4.8); parser mechanism not reported.

tool_count.note: Fixed pipeline nodes, no tool schema reported; harness code unavailable.

edit_primitive.note: Paper: 'returns small, specific edits to apply' (Sec. 4.8); edit syntax unspecified.

protocol_standardization.note: Harness code not available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The automated workflow is implemented as a state graph consisting of 11 steps (Figure 5).
loop_primitives.note: LangGraph StateGraph with compile-dispatch-resolve loop until coverage threshold or iteration limit.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This section provides the stage-by-stage procedure the model should follow.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: some draft the initial UT files, others fix build issues using compiler/linker logs
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialized LLM nodes with different models (GPT-4.1-mini, o4-mini, o3) in fixed graph.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: LangGraph StateGraphhandles the workflow orchestration as a set of steps (nodes) with iterative loops
delegation_mechanism.note: Shared graph state passed between nodes; closest value.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: In interactive mode, this node allows users to provide feedback to the LLM, which will be used to guide the next fix/refinement step.
human_in_loop.note: Interactive vs non-interactive mode selectable; default mode not stated. Feedback at break_point_2 per iteration, closest value on_completion.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: load— Initializes workflow state and validates inputs.
short_term_state.note: LangGraph state holds ut_c/ut_h, do-not-define list, library maps, LCA map.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: a VDB implemented using Chroma stores and retrieves existing functions (knowledge base), existing UTs (ground truth), and reusable test doubles (libraries).
long_term_memory.note: Index of project artifacts, not necessarily written from past runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Compile the test under EDK II, then run the dispatcher when the build succeeds.
self_verification.note: Also compiler/LCOV coverage feedback; prompts include a Validation self-check section (Sec. 4.8).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The system maintains a structured loop that continues until either a coverage threshold is reached or a maximum number of iterations is exceeded.
retry_policy.note: Repair iterations within one run; default limit 10, coverage target 90%.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: (i) the non-interactive coverage target is reached (90% or above by default), (ii) coverage stops improving under break_point_2, or (iii) the workflow reaches its set iteration limit.
termination_condition.note: test_pass is closest value for coverage threshold.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The workflow was instantiated with three commercially available LLMs selected to balance capability and computational cost.
cost_controls.note: Static per-stage model assignment; no budget cap reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: All experiments ran on a Windows machine with the EDK II build environment installed

filesystem_access.note: Edits confined to template TODO blocks, but filesystem policy not reported.

permission_model.note: LLM does not issue actions; fixed nodes execute builds.

tracing.evidence_quote: Runs the UT, saves the run logs, and generates coverage using LCOV

guardrails.evidence_quote: If a symbol is on the list, the workflow avoids generating a new definition for it.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This study introduces an automated UT authoring workflow for the Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (openSIL) firmware codebase

open_source.evidence_quote: Additional code used in this work cannot be made publicly available due to legal and contractual restrictions
open_source.note: Linked openSIL repo is the MIT target codebase, not the harness.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: the LLM interactions are managed throughLangChain ChatOpenAI
model_agnostic.note: OpenAI models only; LangChain could allow others.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: A pseudocode representation of the workflow pipeline developed in this study is provided as Supplementary Material

first_release_date.note: No release; paper v2 dated 21 Jun 2026, v1 date not in evidence.

pinned_version.note: No harness repo; bundled openSIL genoa_poc 632b97619c45 is the target codebase.

stars.note: This is the star count of the openSIL firmware repo linked in the evidence header, not a dedicated harness repo; the record's repo_url is empty. The count was not re-queried via gh api.
